mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and Fed tightening, depressing S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases >0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases >0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.5 million units, it signals a late-cycle expansion phase that often precedes equity market underperformance due to valuation concerns and Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1.5 million units.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals an economic slowdown that may prompt central bank stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS) above 0.5% MoM signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based economic expansion that may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.0% signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.0%.
